description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Supply Runners.
When Supply Runners enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each other creature you control.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.
